panels.title: Scoping proposal validity
panels.query: SELECT status, COALESCE(error_code, 'none') AS error_code, COUNT(*) AS tasks FROM agent_tasks WHERE skill = 'decision-scoping' AND started_at >= :window_start GROUP BY status, COALESCE(error_code, 'none')
panels.rolloutGate: No invalid_output increase and a successful terminal proposal rate of at least 99%.

panels.title: Intake completion and skip
panels.query: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS proposals FROM intake_proposals WHERE created_at >= :window_start GROUP BY status
panels.rolloutGate: Completion and skip rates are reviewed; awaiting_response does not grow without bound.

panels.title: Direct fallback after failed scoping
panels.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT failed.ag_ui_thread_id) AS fallback_threads FROM coordinator_runs AS failed JOIN coordinator_runs AS direct ON direct.ag_ui_thread_id = failed.ag_ui_thread_id AND direct.started_at > failed.finished_at WHERE failed.action_type = 'prepare_research' AND failed.status = 'failed' AND direct.action_type = 'start_research' AND failed.started_at >= :window_start
panels.rolloutGate: Fallback remains available and its rate is investigated before widening rollout.

panels.title: Scoper latency
panels.rolloutGate: p95 remains within the approved one-call latency budget.

panels.title: Scoper token use
panels.rolloutGate: Fixture mode stays at zero; live totals remain within the separately approved budget.

panels.title: Downstream decision quality
panels.rolloutGate: Decision must be eligible and every quality gate must pass before default-on.
